name: Mebok Mizzyrix
summary: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix hires travelers to gather strange finds across the Barrens and beyond. This goblin entrepreneur hopes to turn unusual plants and creatures into profit. His best-known venture is a drink made with raptor horns, meant to sharpen the mind.

sections.title: An Enterprising Alchemist
sections.body: Mebok Mizzyrix works from Ratchet, a neutral port where sailors, pirates and merchants meet. He carries the Steamwheedle spirit of seizing every chance for profit. Rather than deal in ore or cloth, he seeks rare creatures and plants from Kalimdor’s wilds. He believes they can be made into valuable brews and goods.

sections.title: The Smart Drink Venture
sections.body: Mebok’s chief venture is a drink he hopes will boost the drinker’s intellect. He believes the cunning and ferocity of local raptors come from the horns on their snouts. So he hires hunters to bring him whole horns from across the Barrens. Ethics and taste matter less to him than the chance to sell a brew customers believe works.

sections.title: Exotic Reagents and Flora
sections.body: Mebok also seeks strange specimens beyond raptor horns. He wants volatile Deepmoss spider eggs and rare Blueleaf tubers buried in the brambles of Razorfen Kraul. These commissions send mercenaries into dangerous country. Mebok believes any creature or plant with strange properties can be bottled and sold.

faq.answer: Mebok Mizzyrix is a goblin merchant in Ratchet, the neutral port town in the Barrens. He hires travelers to gather strange plants and creatures for his commercial ventures.

Smart Drinks are experimental tonics Mebok Mizzyrix hopes to brew and sell to boost the drinker’s intellect. He believes the horns of clever Barrens raptors will lend the drinker their sharp instincts and cunning.

faq.q: Where can Mebok Mizzyrix be found?
faq.answer: Mebok Mizzyrix can be found among the buildings in Ratchet, on the eastern coast of the Barrens. The port is open to Horde and Alliance travelers.

faq.q: Why does Mebok want raptor horns?
aliases: what does mebok do with horns
faq.answer: Mebok believes the cunning of Barrens raptors lies in their horns. He plans to grind the horns into the primary ingredient for his intellect-enhancing drinks.

faq.q: Why does Mebok send people to Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Mebok sends travelers into Razorfen Kraul to dig up Blueleaf tubers with a trained sniffer. He seeks the rare plant for its valuable and unusual properties.

faq.q: Does Mebok work for the Horde or the Alliance?
faq.answer: Mebok belongs to the Steamwheedle Cartel and is independent in neutral Ratchet. He trades and makes contracts with both Horde and Alliance travelers, in pursuit of coin.

angles.text: Mebok’s interest in Blueleaf tubers shows the commercial side of gathering Kalimdor’s unusual plants.
Mebok’s drink recipes may trouble cooks: he insists on brewing with ground raptor horn.
Horde travelers passing through Ratchet on their way across the Barrens can earn coin by clearing out dangerous beasts nearby.
Alliance travelers arriving by boat from Booty Bay can reach Mebok in neutral Ratchet without fear of hostile guards.
